metadata.title: EnvCoRe-SW public validation and figure-generation code
metadata.description: Version 1.1.0 validates the exact EnvCoRe-SW v5 public ZIP after all v5.5 follow-up corrections. It verifies manifest checksums and CSV metadata; the 19,122 retained/1,392 excluded partition; completed 800-record dual-human-review and 200-record targeted challenge QA; separation of frozen R1/R2 review, HUM_ADJ01 adjudication, deterministic post-review auditing, and final actions; CSV/XLSX and overlap-audit synchronization; record-level application of v5/v5.5 corrections; active schema and controlled vocabularies; table-row-count semantics; column hashes; disclosure controls; and rebuilt figure source data. It does not contain private source reports, readable original report text, source paths, facility names, private crosswalks, or the private extraction and source-review workspace.
